groups.defect: A null destinationCalendar makes the optional push discard collective hosts' calendars when the organizer and event type have no destination calendar.
groups.rationale: All four describe the same initialization and short-circuited append; initializing the array fixes every report.

groups.defect: Reading mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration without a null check crashes Google Meet bookings with no destination calendar.
groups.rationale: Each report identifies the same unchecked property access and the same missing Cal Video fallback.

groups.defect: The organization slug assignment inverts the billing condition, omitting slugs without billing and assigning them prematurely with billing.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same removed negation and require the same correction.

groups.defect: Google updateEvent and deleteEvent search destination calendars using an already-falsy externalCalendarId, losing the destination fallback in both methods.
groups.rationale: All four report the same invalid fallback lookup repeated in update and delete. Both locations require correction.

groups.defect: Office365, Lark, and CalDAV creation select the first host's destination calendar instead of the destination belonging to the active credential.
groups.rationale: Both report incorrect credential-to-destination selection in Office365 and Lark; s_cd578af7 additionally reports the same mistake in CalDAV. The merged comment must preserve all affected implementations.
